special_customer_notification.VIP: A VIP has entered the restaurant!
special_customer_notification.Impatient: An impatient customer has entered the restaurant!
special_customer_notification.FoodCritic: A food critic has entered the restaurant!
special_customer_notification.Hobo: A hobo has entered the restaurant!
special_customer_notification.Celebrity: A celebrity has entered the restaurant!

special_customer_descriptions.VIP: VIPs require a dish quality of at least 50 and pay a double bonus.
special_customer_descriptions.Impatient: Impatient customers have half the usual patience.
special_customer_descriptions.FoodCritic: Food critics judge dish quality: a high-quality dish boosts other customers' patience, while a low-quality dish reduces it.
special_customer_descriptions.Hobo: Hobos leave after eating, interact with them before they leave to collect payment. They also don't mind trash food.
special_customer_descriptions.Celebrity: Pauses patience of all customers in the restaurants, pays 3x bonus, but more demanding in order and quality. (>80% dish quality requirement)

error.order_dish_requirement_not_fulfilled: This dish does not match the customer's order/requirement.
error.delivering_empty_handed: You need to be holding a cooked dish/consumable to deliver it.
error.uncooked_ingredient_error: Ingredients cannot be delivered. Cook them first!

customer_action_notification.leaving_out_of_patience: %s is out of patience and is leaving.
